scope: User-approved complete control library and repository-intake draft wizard; no authorization is issued by tooling

items.title: Pinned catalog and baseline inputs
items.acceptance: Official catalog and Low/Moderate/High selections pinned; user-approved 58-control LATO reference explicitly labeled

items.title: Control-specific sample library
items.acceptance: Every catalog control/enhancement has description, hidden illustrative example, questions, evidence guidance and source links; withdrawn controls handled distinctly
items.verification: 1196 files: 1014 active parameterized templates and 182 withdrawal dispositions; deterministic generation and all-control composition verified

items.title: Repository clarification and generation workflow
items.acceptance: Read-only bounded repository intake, durable questions/answers, explicit baseline selection, editable draft/control/diagram generation; reruns preserve team work
items.verification: CLI intake/ask/generate/export implemented; independent guard/preservation review cleared; semantic code review remains WIZ-05

items.title: End-to-end verification and instructions
items.acceptance: Actual synthetic LATO/full-ATO builds and diagram rendering, library completeness, example exclusion, portable CLI tests, documented unknowns and limits
items.verification: Actual LATO/Low/Moderate DOCX builds and High generation; all diagram bytes checked; comments excluded; all 1196 response blocks compose

items.title: Evidence-backed semantic repository mapping
items.trigger: After path-intake and answer contracts stabilize
items.acceptance: Bounded source-reading adapters produce revision/path-backed mechanisms and proposed per-part narratives; user confirms unresolved applicability; never turn filename presence into passed control

items.title: Distinct architecture projections and agency tailoring
items.trigger: Real system topology and agency requirements supplied; user requested diagram semantics correction
items.acceptance: Generate view-specific context/container/boundary/data-flow models, supported privacy/agency overlays and explicit tailoring decisions; not four identical topology seeds

items.title: Common-control references and candidate inheritance
items.acceptance: Import four requested component definitions unchanged; ask service/applicability/enrollment/SHA questions; preserve source rules and part IDs; include unresolved responsibility report in export; preserve user edits
items.verification: Four exact-copy hashes, 12 toolkit +62 framework tests zero skips, actual LATO DOCX with 121 candidate mappings, blocker review clear

items.title: Confirmed inheritance into formal OSCAL assembly
items.trigger: Current provider scope, customer prerequisites and owner decisions supplied
items.acceptance: Map approved provider/common/hybrid allocations to OSCAL by-component statements without importing source status as system effectiveness; retain per-part evidence and remaining responsibility

items.title: Resumable Textual terminal interface
items.acceptance: One start/resume command, preserved legacy answers, date defaults, normalized choices, inline validation, autosave/navigation and headless real-generation tests
items.verification: Original 28 focused tests passed; topology moved to separate flow under WIZ-10 rather than required text configuration

items.title: Separate source-proposed diagram review from text configuration
items.acceptance: Text UI and CLI generate without topology; legacy diagram work preserved; independent source-cited proposal/clarification/review/render flow with durable human answers and attachment command
items.verification: 95 framework cases exercised across authoring/TUI environments; real source proposal/render and stale-attachment regressions pass; independent review cleared

items.title: State-aware Textual diagram dashboard and explicit runner
items.acceptance: One start/resume command, exact handoff request, auto-validating proposal detection, readable questions, explicit review, preview/generate/render/attach, runner errors preserved and never mistaken for analysis success
items.verification: Six Textual and ten backend tests pass including real rendering; root 12+112 with four optional integration skips; independent three-blocker re-review cleared

items.title: Agent capability and offline operation policy assessment
items.acceptance: Document actual behavior and gaps for manual/local/approved-hosted modes, separate source-transfer policy from network enforcement, propose capability discovery and offline setup without silently invoking providers
items.verification: Coordinator and independent read-only audit; docs/kit/agent-offline-assessment.md records verified code behavior and unimplemented recommendations

items.title: First-class manual mode and truthful proposal authorship
items.acceptance: No-LLM manual path clearly available; proposal author/method distinct from tool attribution; existing approved agent handoff optional; unknown capabilities do not trigger provider fallback

items.title: Local capability preflight and declared execution policy
items.trigger: Owner selects supported execution modes and source-transfer rules
items.acceptance: Locally detect tools without network probes or credential discovery; persist allowed modes and show prohibited/missing capabilities; never claim declaration equals OS egress enforcement

items.title: Offline preparation and installation bundle
items.trigger: Target OS/Python/platform and approved acquisition process selected
items.acceptance: Explicit local wheelhouse/tool/catalog sources, pinned hashes, no-index offline install and disconnected acceptance test; fail rather than downloading missing artifacts

items.title: Decide runner containment and provenance requirements
items.trigger: Before allowing runner use where filesystem, credentials or network must be restricted
items.acceptance: Document enforcing sandbox/egress boundary and credential scope or approved trusted-process model; decide required request/executable/model and transfer metadata without logging secrets

items.title: Unified launcher and owned in-repository docs workspace
items.acceptance: Root ato-wizard command, separate text/diagram choice, docs default with timestamp collision fallback, resume, shared ownership guards and generated-doc exclusions across all consumers
items.verification: Six chooser, seven workspace and one dispatcher tests; root 12+126 successful with four optional integration skips; two independently reproduced path blockers fixed and cleared
